services.name: Kayak rental
services.desc: How is my Morro Bay kayak tour with Wildheart Coastal Adventures different from the other kayak companies? Wildheart offers a unique kayak experience that includes a short hike to a popular viewpoint to have a panoramic view of the estuary and to get insight into the estuary as a unique and abundant ecosystem. This opportunity enables you to get a feel for the features and extensiveness of the estuary. All of our guides have the educational background and experience to point out the varied flora and fauna both on land and in the estuarine environment…a true and informative eco-tour.
